facts.fact: A government communique of 2026-08-24 says Cote d'Ivoire is continuing its FCFA 38 billion Programme national de connectivite rurale to bring mobile network and internet access to 575 localities, with phase two (FCFA 18 billion, 240 localities) and phase three (FCFA 10 billion, 160 localities) following.
The government says phase one of the PNCR, completed in 2024, built 160 radio sites in 175 localities, benefiting about 221,267 inhabitants.
